Chapter 754: Chapter 34: Through The Ages (8000 Words, Please Subscribe)_4

Chapter 754: Chapter 34: Through the Ages (8000 words, please subscribe)_4

The Twelfth Rank Supreme Being could indeed withstand being pulled into ‘White Paper,’ but once they fell into it, they’d similarly be suppressed, barely able to display some extraordinary powers, much like those oddities.

But that was all.

There was still an immensely long way to go to break free from the suppression of the Two-dimensional World.

…

Luo River gathering area.

After leaving the summit of Heavenly Mountain, Lin Yuan returned here.

...

“After Witch Ancestor Fifty Realm, the difficulty of advancing further vastly exceeds that before the fifty realms,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

This was also the goal he had set for himself, which is why he aimed to only cultivate up to Witch Ancestor Hundredth Realm before the next door to the Heavenly realm opened.

It took over three hundred years to reach the Witch Ancestor Fiftieth Realm, but the subsequent ten thousand years brought only an increase to the Hundredth Realm because the space for progress after the fiftieth realm was too small.

The difficulty from the Fiftieth to the Eleventh Realm would likely exceed that from the first to the fiftieth realm.

“Conventional seclusion doesn’t have much effect,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

…

“In fact, even if I can’t push open the heavenly gate, I still have a possibility to escape the Two-dimensional World,” Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

Supreme Beings couldn’t rescue anyone through ‘White Paper,’ but Lin Yuan, by using the ‘Door to the Myriad Realms,’ more precisely, the physical body transit of the Door to the Myriad Realms, could indeed leave this Two-dimensional World.

It only cost fifty strands of World-Breaking Origin Force.

But there was still a problem with doing so.

That was, after ending the transit, when his Taiyang Divine Spirit returned to the Main Universe, would it still appear inside the Two-dimensional World?

If it did appear again, such corporeal transit would be meaningless because it would still be suppressed by the Two-dimensional World.

Moreover, the spirit will’s transit method of the Door to the Myriad Realms faced this same issue of whether it would still appear in the Two-dimensional World upon return.

“Let’s continue observing.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts.

Unless absolutely necessary, Lin Yuan wouldn’t easily resort to this method.

Directly disappearing from within the Two-dimensional World? Current signs indicate that the ‘White Paper’ squeezed into the universe might possess an independent will.

At the very least, it seemed to be an entity similar to the Spirit of the Mysterious Realm in Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Otherwise, how could one explain the altered difficulty of opening the heavenly gate after the arrival of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses?

Therefore.

Directly using the Door to the Myriad Realms to escape from the Two-dimensional World, even if just temporarily, would certainly attract the attention of that being within the Two-dimensional World itself.

Escaping the suppressive restrictions of the Two-dimensional World isn’t something even a Twelfth Rank Supreme Being can do lightly, and for Lin Yuan to do so would be too conspicuous.

As for Lin Yuan, the worst plan would be to abandon his Taiyang Divine Spirit, even if it resulted in defects in the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, but with Against-Heaven’s Understanding, it wasn’t impossible to make up for the deficiencies.

Even if he couldn’t compensate, since Lin Yuan was able to pave a Martial Path Evolutionary Path, he could also develop other evolutionary paths not weaker than the Martial Dao, simply switching to another evolutionary path.

Given Lin Yuan’s current status in human civilization, starting over would be much easier than before.

…

After a moment of contemplation.

Lin Yuan’s spirit turned back to cultivation.

“When activating Divine Skill ‘Enhancement,’ my spirit will significantly sharpens, furthering my control over power, and from there revealing more about the true essence of this world,”

Lin Yuan mused to himself.

“If I get a chance next, I might as well frequently activate Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Enhancement’….”

The biggest risk of Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Enhancement’ is that after its activation, it leads to a brief period of weakness.

But if one ensures being in a sufficiently safe environment, it can also serve as a method of cultivation.

The strengthening of the spirit will not only greatly benefit Lin Yuan’s understanding of the essence of the power in this Two-dimensional World,

but the comprehension of many laws by the true body in the outside world will also improve in efficiency as the spirit strengthens, enhancing performance in all aspects.

As for the subsequent period of weakness, it’s merely a weakening of strength, with no actual impact on the comprehension of laws.

…

Xia You Evolution Tower.

Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan, concerned, and asked, “Is the heavenly gate truly impenetrable?”

The inability to open the heavenly gate had already been recognized by the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, even the human ‘Blood Rain,’ who dominated over the Four Divine Kings, couldn’t open it; it almost pronounced the death sentence of all the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses within the Two-dimensional World.

However, Xia Qin Supreme Being still wanted to understand more about the situation.

“It can’t be pushed open,”

Lin Yuan said, nodding his head.

There was no need to lie or hide anything in front of a Supreme Being.

“This is troubling,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being said, somewhat headache-prone.

If the heavenly gate couldn’t be opened, it meant Lin Yuan couldn’t leave the Two-dimensional World on his own initiative.

And outside the painting, these Supreme Beings couldn’t influence the interior of the Two-dimensional World either, equating to falling into a vicious cycle.

While some Supreme Beings proposed to wait and see, perhaps there would be a change after the next opening of the heavenly gate,

Xia Qin Supreme Being was still quite worried.

“What are your plans now?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being asked.

“Continue cultivating, waiting for the next opening of the heavenly gate,” Lin Yuan said calmly.

“Good.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being nodded, sensing that Lin Yuan’s mindset had not been affected at all, which was quite exceptional.

Many strong individuals could persevere in the face of adversity.

But to remain unyielding in the face of a hopeless or deadly situation was exceedingly difficult.

Undoubtedly, the three hundred years before the arrival of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses in the Two-dimensional World were the years of greatest strength improvement, already reaching the world’s bottleneck.

Even after another ten thousand years, the improvement in personal strength might not be as significant as in those first three hundred years.
